title: 卷一江湖少年 第九章东海英雄会卷一江湖少年 第十章大婚在即
slug: 梦启东梁第一四零六章蛛丝有毒

东海英雄会
平川城，长刀门所在。
“爹，鲸蛟会的洪庆已经带着家小出城了，我们要不要。
？“长刀门二公子赵康做了个斩的手势。
“穷寇莫追，“赵如安挥了挥手，端坐在正堂的座椅上，”
那洪庆昨天找了五音亭的外门管事来做中间人，现在和五音亭的婚期就要到了，在此之前，多一事不如少一事。
“可如果任由他们离开的话，斩草不除根，先不说养虎为患，怕是江湖上的其他势力也会认为咱们好欺负了。
“赵康在一旁有些担忧。
“只是暂时不动他们罢了，“赵如安看向自己这个二儿子，”
等你和李长老的弟子成婚，莫说是一个洪庆，就算是整个东海郡还不是任你予取予求。
“父亲说的是，“赵康拱手道。
“你大哥那里如何了？“略过了这个话题，赵如安关心起了大儿子的伤势。
“伤势已经稳住了，“赵康闻言道，”
那龙啸也是有些势力，大哥和二叔两人联手也只是把他拼成了重伤，现在落入海中不知下落，以后怕也是我们的一个隐患。
当日赵飞与赵二两人联手之下，只不过是令得龙啸断了一臂，最后仍旧是被他跳海逃了，而为了龙啸的这一条手臂，赵飞也被龙啸一刀背砸在了胸口，断了三根肋骨。
“龙啸已经是残废之人，不足为虑，”
赵如安抬手拿起一旁的茶盏，声音缓缓的传来，“眼下的当务之急是和五音亭的婚事，这次你亲自带人走一趟，把聘礼送到李长老府上，不能再出丝毫的岔子了。”
“父亲放心，”
赵康点头道，“孩儿心里有数。”

赵如安闻言点了点头，放下手中的茶盏，起身向后院走去。
“我去看看你大哥，你先下去准备吧。”
赵康拱手相送，看着赵如安离去的背影，眉头微微皱了皱。
赵如安的两个儿子中，他最看好的还是长子赵飞，不仅武功不凡，手段心智都是继承门主之位的首选，至于自己的这个小儿子赵康则是少了几份稳重。
只不过如今五音亭那里看中了赵康作为女婿，长刀门之后定然是要以五音亭为首的，如此来看，长刀门下任门主的人选就要好好斟酌了。
另一边，离开平川城后，隋缘一路向北，随着人流不紧不慢的走着。
这天夜里，隋缘夜宿在一个破庙里，买了干粮后他身上剩下的钱不多了，小乞丐也根本没有住旅店的想法，能有一座破庙栖身就是最好的光景了。
骤然从城主府的繁华回到这四处漏风的破庙，隋缘没有感到丝毫的不适，反而像是鱼如大海一般，心中有种说不出的自在。
将干粮在火堆上烤了烤，隋缘抱膝坐在火堆前，双眼盯着眼前跃动的火苗，心思却不知道飞去了哪里。
“师兄，前面有座破庙，我们在这里避下雨再走吧！”
外面忽然传来一道女子的声音，打算了隋缘的思绪。
皱了皱眉，隋缘眼中闪过一抹不喜。
“师妹，里面看样子已经有人先到，我先去打个招呼。”
一名男子的声音传来，想来应该就是先前说话那女子口中的师兄了。
没多久，一名身着劲装，外面照着一袭锦袍的男子迈步走了进来，目光扫过，见里面只有隋缘一人，于是向隋缘抱拳道，“这位小兄弟，在下大青山浮光派李素，今日与师妹路过此地，想寻个落脚的地方，还请寻个方便？”
“这又不是我的地方，”
隋缘闻言翻了个白眼，“你们想来就要想走就走，跟我说什么！”

East China Sea Heroes Association
Pingchuan City, where the Changdao Gate is located.
“Dad, Hong Qing from the Whale Dragon Society has taken his family out of the city, do we want him?
? "Zhao Kang, the second son of the Changdao Clan, made a beheading gesture.
"Don't chase after poor bandits," Zhao Ru'an waved his hand and sat on the chair in the main hall, "
Yesterday, Hong Qing found Wuyinting's outer steward to be the middleman. Now his wedding to Wuyinting is coming. Before that, it is better to do less than to do more.
"But if we let them leave, we will cut the grass without eradicating the roots, let alone raising tigers to cause trouble. I am afraid that other forces in the world will think that we are easy to bully.
"Zhao Kang was a little worried on the side.
"Just don't move them for the time being," Zhao Ru'an looked at his second son, "
When you get married to Elder Li's disciple, let alone Hong Qing, even the entire Donghai County will not be at your mercy.
"That's what father said," Zhao Kang said with his hands in hand.
"How's your eldest brother doing?" Zhao Ru'an ignored the topic and became concerned about his eldest son's injury.
"The injury has been stabilized," Zhao Kang said after hearing this.
That Long Xiao also has some power. The eldest brother and the second uncle worked together to only seriously injure him. Now that he fell into the sea and his whereabouts are unknown, he may be a hidden danger for us in the future.
Zhao Fei and Zhao Er joined forces that day, but they only broke Long Xiao's arm. In the end, he jumped into the sea and escaped. For Long Xiao's arm, Zhao Fei was hit in the chest with the back of Long Xiao's knife, breaking three ribs.
"Long Xiao is already a disabled person, so there is nothing to worry about."
Zhao Ru'an raised his hand to pick up the tea cup on the side, and his voice came slowly, "The top priority right now is the marriage with Wuyinting. This time you will personally take the people there and deliver the betrothal gift to Elder Li's house. No more mistakes can be made. "
"Father, don't worry,"
Zhao Kang nodded and said, "My child knows what he is doing. "
Zhao Ru'an nodded when he heard this, put down the tea cup in his hand, stood up and walked to the backyard.
"I'm going to see your brother, you go down and get ready first. "
Zhao Kang gave him his hands and looked at Zhao Ruan's leaving figure, frowning slightly.
Among Zhao Ru'an's two sons, the eldest son Zhao Fei is the one he likes the most. Not only does he have extraordinary martial arts skills, but he is also the first choice to inherit the position of sect leader. As for his younger son Zhao Kang, he lacks some stability.
But now that Wuyinting has chosen Zhao Kang as his son-in-law, Wuyinting will definitely be the leader of the Changdao Sect. From this point of view, the candidate for the next leader of the Changdao Sect must be carefully considered.
On the other side, after leaving Pingchuan City, Sui Yuan headed north, walking leisurely with the flow of people.
That night, Sui Yuan stayed in a dilapidated temple. After buying dry food, he didn't have much money left on him. The little beggar had no idea of staying in a hotel. Having a dilapidated temple to live in was the best situation.
Sui Yuan suddenly returned from the prosperity of the city lord's palace to this dilapidated temple that was leaking from all directions. Sui Yuan did not feel the slightest discomfort. Instead, he felt like a fish in the sea, with an indescribable sense of ease in his heart.
After roasting the dry food on the fire, Sui Yuan hugged his knees and sat in front of the fire, staring at the dancing flames in front of him, but his thoughts flew to nowhere.
"Brother, there is a ruined temple in front of us. Let's take shelter from the rain here before leaving! "
Suddenly a woman's voice came from outside, changing Sui Yuan's thoughts.
Sui Yuan frowned, a flash of displeasure flashed in his eyes.
"Junior sister, it looks like someone has already arrived inside, so I'll go say hello first. "
A man's voice came, presumably it was the senior brother mentioned by the woman who spoke earlier.
Not long after, a man in smart clothes and a brocade robe walked in. He glanced around and saw that Sui Yuan was the only one inside, so he clasped his fists at Sui Yuan and said, "This little brother, I am Li Su of Daqingshan Fuguang Sect. I passed by here with my junior sister today and want to find a place to stay. Could you please do me a favor?" ""This is not my place,"
Sui Yuan rolled his eyes when he heard this, "You can come and leave whenever you want. What do you say to me?"
